g.text: Original SWD10 model · 64 conditions · 100 profiles per condition · 353 validation meters

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #343a40

g.text: Points: paired estimates. Lines: separate 95% descriptive meter-bootstrap intervals (500 draws).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #343a40

g.text: Negative differences favor the calibrated cGAN; positive differences favor the comparator.

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #515963

g.text: Models, maps and generated references are held fixed. Intervals exclude training and selection uncertainty.

text.style: font-size: 9.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #515963

g.text: No intervals are pooled or averaged. Validation remains exploratory; this figure does not establish publication readiness.
